question: Who took oath as the Governor of Meghalaya in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **BD Mishra** on** October 4 **took oath as the **new governor of Meghalaya** at a function in the **Raj Bhavan in Shillong.**
 
• **BD Mishra**, the former brigadier of the** Indian Army, **has been serving as the **Arunachal Pradesh governor since 2017.**
 
• He has been given the additional charge of neighbouring** Meghalaya.**
 
• He succeeded **Satya Pal Malik** who completed his term as the **Meghalaya governor on October 3.**
 
• Assembly Speaker **Metbah Lyngdoh** and senior cabinet ministers were present at the function.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Unlike many Indian states**, Meghalaya** has historically followed a matrilineal system where the** lineage and inheritance** are traced through women; the youngest daughter inherits all wealth and she also takes care of her parents.
 
• The state is the **wettest region of India**, with the wettest areas in the southern Khasi Hills recording an average of **12,000 mm** of rain a year.
